The Studio

An elite chair experience in Dallas

At Nitafades Studio, every appointment is about detail — clean lines, precise fades and a finish that holds its shape. From the signature Elite Cut to the Full Grooming Package, the focus stays the same: unhurried work, sharp results and a studio experience that feels premium from the moment you sit down.

Families are part of the studio too. Youth Signature Cuts for ages 3–12 and the First-Haircut Specialty are handled with patience and care, making a first visit to the chair a comfortable one.
